title: Heaven
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Heaven is the blessed dwelling of God where believers who die in Christ are immediately with the Lord, awaiting bodily resurrection and the final fullness of God’s eternal kingdom. The believer’s hope includes conscious presence with Christ, resurrection glory, and eternal life in the New Heavens and New Earth.
summary: Heaven is the blessed dwelling of God where believers who die in Christ are immediately with the Lord, awaiting bodily resurrection and the final fullness of God’s eternal kingdom. The believer’s hope includes conscious presence with Christ, resurrection glory, and eternal life in the New Heavens and New Earth.
christFocus: Jesus Christ opens the way to heaven through His death, resurrection, ascension, and intercession. He prepares a place for His people, receives them into His presence at death, and will bring them into the fullness of resurrection life and eternal fellowship with God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Heaven is not a vague dream, empty symbol, or sentimental idea. It is the blessed presence of God and the certain hope of those who belong to Christ.

When believers die, they are not lost, asleep in hopelessness, or separated from the care of Christ. They are with the Lord. Jesus told the repentant thief that he would be with Him in Paradise.

Heaven also points forward to the fullness of redemption. Believers who are with Christ await bodily resurrection and the final renewal of all things.

The final hope of God’s people is the New Heavens and New Earth, where God dwells with His redeemed people forever. Heaven is immediate comfort at death and final hope in the completed kingdom.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people fear death, wonder what happens after this life, or imagine heaven in ways shaped more by culture than Scripture. This doctrine gives believers solid hope: those who die in Christ are immediately with the Lord.

Heaven also strengthens suffering believers. Pain, disability, grief, rejection, weakness, and loss are not the final chapter. Christ has prepared a place for His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Set your hope on the Lord and His eternal kingdom. Do not treat this life as though it is all there is, and do not grieve as those without hope. Let the promise of being with Christ strengthen endurance, comfort you in loss, and stir worship.
